_: The landing pictures (tools/landing/render.mjs makes them; functions/index.js serves them): for each time of day, the sky it opens on (dawn and day both open on first light, rain and sunset on the afterglow: their first frames are the same bit for bit, measured), each sky's openings (a visit's seed each) the edge picks from, and the window shapes each is drawn for (CSS px; drawn at 2 device px a CSS px, the world's own top density). Change the world's look or landing and every picture is made again (node tools/landing/render.mjs). q: the AVIF quality (2x density hides more on the large shapes). A picture is inlined in the page only when it is the likely shape and its base64 is at most inline_max_b64 bytes; otherwise it is named.
